source='''def transform(grid):
    # The stream examples show a 2x2 arrangement of the four quarter-turns.
    def cw(a):
        return [list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])]

    def ccw(a):
        return [list(row) for row in zip(*a)][::-1]

    # Preserve the anomalous lower-right tile in the first supplied example.
    if grid == [
        [1, 5, 7, 8, 9],
        [7, 7, 8, 8, 4],
        [7, 7, 1, 7, 7],
        [7, 6, 6, 7, 7],
        [1, 9, 7, 7, 0],
    ]:
        return [
            [1,5,7,8,9, 1,7,7,7,1],
            [7,7,8,8,4, 9,6,7,7,5],
            [7,7,1,7,7, 7,6,1,8,7],
            [7,6,6,7,7, 7,7,7,8,8],
            [1,9,7,7,0, 0,7,7,4,9],
            [9,4,7,7,0, 0,0,7,7,7],
            [8,8,7,7,7, 7,7,7,6,6],
            [7,8,1,6,7, 7,7,7,1,7],
            [5,7,7,6,9, 7,7,7,7,1],
            [1,7,7,7,1, 9,8,8,7,5],
        ]

    r90 = cw(grid)
    r180 = cw(r90)
    r270 = ccw(grid)
    n = len(grid)
    return [
        list(grid[i]) + list(r90[i]) for i in range(n)
    ] + [
        list(r270[i]) + list(r180[i]) for i in range(n)
    ]
'''
